chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Abu Ayyub, from Abu al-Ward, from Abu Ja‘far عليه السلام, who said:
The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله addressed the people on the last Friday of Sha‘ban. He praised Allah and extolled Him, then said:
O people, indeed a month has approached you in which there is a night

And it is the Month of Ramadan. Allah has made its fasting obligatory, and He has made standing in one night of it like one who performs voluntary salat for seventy nights in other months. He has made for one who performs in it a trait from the traits of goodness and righteousness the reward of one who performs an obligation from the obligations of Allah, Mighty and Majestic. And whoever performs an obligation from the obligations of Allah is like one who performs seventy obligations in other months. It is the month of patience, and indeed the reward of patience is Paradise. It is the month of mutual support, and it is a month in which Allah increases the provision of the believer. Whoever gives a fasting believer something with which to break the fast will have thereby with Allah the freeing of a slave and forgiveness for his past sins.

So it was said to him: O Messenger of Allah, not all of us are able to give a fasting person something to break the fast with. So he said: Indeed Allah, Blessed and Exalted, is Generous. He gives this reward from among you to one who is not able except for a sip of milk by which he gives a fasting person to break the fast, or a drink of sweet water, or a few dates, and is not able to do more than that. And whoever lightens the burden upon his servant in it, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, will lighten his reckoning.

And it is a month whose beginning is mercy, its middle is forgiveness, and its end is response and freedom from the Fire. And you have no sufficiency in it without four qualities: two qualities by which you please Allah, and two qualities without which you have no sufficiency. As for the two by which you please Allah, they are the testimony that there is no god but Allah and that I am the Messenger of Allah. And as for the two without which you have no sufficiency, they are that you ask Allah, Mighty and Majestic, in it for your needs and for Paradise, and that you ask Allah in it for well-being and seek refuge in Him from the Fire.

key_terms.الصَّبْرِ: patience and steadfastness, whose reward is Paradise
key_terms.النَّارِ: the Fire, from which refuge is sought
key_terms.الْجَنَّةَ: Paradise, requested from Allah in this month
key_terms.الْمُوَاسَاةِ: mutual support and sharing with others
key_terms.شَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ: the Month of Ramadan, the sacred month of fasting and multiplied reward
key_terms.صِيَامَهُ: its fasting, made obligatory by Allah
key_terms.قِيَامَ لَيْلَةٍ: standing in worship at night during Ramadan

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله say about the virtues and duties of the Month of Ramadan?
ai.summary: This hadith is a sermon of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله on the virtues of the Month of Ramadan, emphasizing fasting, night worship, patience, charity, and care for others. It presents Ramadan as a month of mercy, forgiveness, answered supplication, and deliverance from the Fire, while urging the believers to renew shahadah, ask for Paradise, and seek protection from the Fire.
